description: Use this when an authenticated SIMcloud user asks to buy prepaid electricity for a meter already confirmed with check_electricity_meter. Confirm the meter, rand amount, reference and SMS recipient before calling. This spends wallet funds and submits an irreversible external transaction; do not automatically retry an ambiguous result.

amount.description: Electricity purchase amount in whole South African rand (no cents), from R55 to R1000.

client_reference.description: User or system reference for this electricity order.

meter_number.description: Prepaid electricity meter number previously checked with check_electricity_meter.

recipient.description: Recipient mobile number for voucher notifications.

name: create_electricity_order

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Create electricity order
